memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: headache and elevated blood pressure readings at home.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: The patient reports intermittent frontal headaches over the past two weeks and notes home BP readings averaging 148/92 mmHg. He denies chest pain, palpitations, or visual disturbances.
EXAMINATION: BP 150/94 mmHg, pulse 78/min, regular. Weight 70 kg, height 1.75 m, BMI 22.9 (normal). Cardiovascular exam reveals normal S1S2, no murmurs. Lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Stage 1 hypertension, asymptomatic. No evidence of end‑organ damage.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start amlodipine 5 mg OD and telmisartan 40 mg OD. Order fasting serum creatinine, eGFR, serum potassium, and ECG. Advise low‑salt diet, weight control, and return if headache worsens, chest pain, breathlessness, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine hypertension follow‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional mild headaches, otherwise well. Home BP averages 146/90 mmHg.
EXAMINATION: BP 148/92 mmHg, pulse 80/min. Weight 71 kg, BMI 23.2 (overweight). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams unchanged.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension not yet at target; consider adding third agent.
ARRANGEMENTS: Add losartan 50 mg OD. Reinforce low‑salt diet, increase fruits/vegetables, aim for 150 min/week brisk walking. Return if headache becomes severe, chest pain, breathlessness, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine check‑up and lab review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels well, no headaches. Home BP averages 132/84 mmHg.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/82 mmHg, pulse 76/min. Weight 72 kg, BMI 23.5 (overweight). Cardiovascular exam normal.
IMPRESSION: Blood pressure now at target; renal function and electrolytes stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current regimen. Advise maintaining DASH diet, regular aerobic activity, and weight goal <70 kg. Return if BP rises above 140/90, chest pain, breathlessness, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: intermittent fever and raised home BP.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports 3‑day low‑grade fever (max 38.5°C) and sore throat, plus home BP up to 158/96 mmHg.
EXAMINATION: BP 156/98 mmHg, pulse 84/min, temperature 38.2°C. Weight 73 kg, BMI 23.8 (overweight). Throat mildly erythematous, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Viral upper respiratory infection with transient hypertension exacerbation.
ARRANGEMENTS: Add hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD. Continue amlodipine, telmisartan, losartan. Advise hydration, antipyretics as needed, and return if fever >39°C, chest pain, breathlessness, or worsening headache.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of electrolytes after starting thiazide.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient asymptomatic, no fever. Home BP averages 138/88 mmHg.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/86 mmHg, pulse 78/min. Weight 73 kg, BMI 23.8 (overweight). No edema.
IMPRESSION: Mild hypokalemia likely due to hydrochlorothiazide; renal function stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current drugs. Encourage potassium‑rich diet (bananas, oranges, coconut water). Return if muscle weakness, cramps, chest pain, breathlessness, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: annual review and influenza vaccination.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient well, no symptoms. Home BP averages 130/82 mmHg.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/80 mmHg, pulse 76/min. Weight 73.5 kg, BMI 24.0 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Hypertension controlled on four‑drug regimen. No adverse effects.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD. Offer influenza vaccine; patient consents and receives vaccine today (2026-09-30). Advise maintain low‑salt diet, regular exercise, and weight target <73 kg. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or BP >140/90.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: post‑vaccination check and medication review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports mild arm soreness at injection site, otherwise well. Home BP 128/80 mmHg.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/78 mmHg, pulse 74/min. Weight 73.5 kg, BMI 24.0 (overweight). No local reaction beyond mild tenderness.
IMPRESSION: Influenza vaccine tolerated. Hypertension remains well controlled.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current regimen. No change advised. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or BP >140/90.
